manifest.interpretation: V42 established peer breadth as a high-value entry state but retained two spring hard-stop losses. These experiments keep source score, risk and trailing/ROI fixed and ask whether the peer state remains a valid thesis during the trade. Compare gross-profit preservation, hard-stop compression, re-entry side effects, actual-fill validity and independent episodes.

purpose: Decompose the EDTMA system without reducing it to a pass/fail gate. Measure condition reentry versus independent episodes, source versus corrected chandelier exits, source versus structural risk geometry, winner preservation, loss concentration and implementation validity.
